title: Quiz: Cascade Layers
description: Check your understanding of Cascade Layers.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: In CSS, /* */ marks a comment. Block comments use /* ... */.

questions.question: What problem do cascade layers solve?
questions.correctAnswer: Specificity conflicts regardless of selector strength

questions.question: True or False: Layers give predictable ordering without !important.
What is the main purpose of the Cascade Layers technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you cascade layers effectively.

questions.question: In CSS, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
